text:
Sophie (People Ops): quick question — Diego had to overnight in BOS last night after UA123 got canceled. He covered hotel + valet ($28) and a dinner ($62) on his personal card but the restaurant only gave a card slip, no itemized receipt. What do we need to reimburse?

travel-bot: Automated notice: Flight UA123 canceled 2026-03-22 21:40. Rebooked to UA456 next morning. Delay recorded in travel system (REF: FLT-19451).

Diego (Eng): yep that was me. i have the hotel folio, the card authorization slip from the restaurant, and screenshots of the boarding pass + rebook email.

Ken (Finance): hotel folio is fine for lodging. for meals under $75 we prefer an itemized receipt. if one isn't available there are two common paths: manager attestation OR claim per-diem (country-specific). please ping your manager for attestation.

Maya (People Ops Manager): i can approve a manager attestation here. Diego — please attach a short note stating: 1) trip reason, 2) confirmation of charge amount, 3) that you tried to obtain an itemized receipt. i'll sign off.

Sophie (People Ops): steps to submit (easy copy):
```
1) Upload hotel folio PDF + boarding pass screenshot
2) Upload restaurant card slip and a 1-2 sentence attestation (see Maya's list)
3) Upload valet parking receipt (or photo of machine/statement if paperless) and tag as 'Other - Transportation'
4) In the expense form, assign cost center: ENG-Platform
5) Add Maya (People Ops Manager) as approver
OR: if you prefer per-diem, mark meal as 'Per diem' and select 'BOS - USA' region.
```

Diego (Eng): do i need to fill an exception form for the missing itemized meal receipt?

Maya (People Ops Manager): not for this amount. manager attestation is sufficient. exception form required only when missing receipt AND amount > $75 or unusual spend.

Ken (Finance): once approved we'll process within 5 business days. if you need faster processing reply here with 'urgent' and we'll triage.

Sophie (People Ops): I'll watch for the submission and confirm once finance queues it. @Diego can you submit by EOD so we can close the loop? :slightly_smiling_face:

Diego (Eng): submitting now, attaching folio + slip + attestation. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sophie (People Ops): got it — marked as submitted. will update when reimbursed.

Ken (Finance): reimbursed on 2026-03-26, posted to Diego's payroll item. Diego you'll get the notification to your email.

Diego (Eng): confirmed receipt email — thanks all!
